Kevin used to be in Procurement, and now he's part of the Supply Chain Operations team in B04. I want that transfer date and department on record.

Perfect, that's exactly what I need. I've been working with B04 more often recently because my finance reports depend on their quarterly inventory reconciliation data. It's one of those cross-department dependencies that can be stressful when timelines slip. Having all these details organized helps me stay on top of things without scrambling at the last minute.

That makes a lot of sense — when your finance deadlines hinge on another department's deliverables, knowing exactly who to contact and where they sit can shave off valuable time.
